stimulus.title: New gym hours
stimulus.body:
Starting Monday, the campus gym will open at 6 am instead of 7 am.
The pool stays closed until the end of the month for repairs.
Bring your student card: you need it to enter.

options.rationale: A is right: 6 am is earlier than 7 am.
B is wrong: the pool stays closed.
C is wrong: the closing time is not mentioned.
D is wrong: the card is only needed to enter.

explanation.summary: The email says the gym will open at 6 am instead of 7 am.

options.rationale: A is wrong: the weather is not mentioned.

options.text: It is reserved for a team
options.rationale: C is wrong: no team is mentioned.
D is wrong: weekends are not mentioned.

explanation.summary: The email says the pool is closed for repairs.
